name: Claude Agent Skills Pack 🧰
description_md:
# What You Get

- CSV → Slides automator: a ready-to-run skill that turns spreadsheets into presentation-ready PowerPoints (tables + charts).

- Revenue forecaster: ML-powered time-series forecasting (Prophet) with plots, confidence intervals, and CSV outputs for planning.

- Sales pipeline health analyzer: conversion funnels, win-rate by source, cycle-length analysis, and an exportable pipeline report.

- Pitch deck builder: converts rough notes into a polished 10-slide investor or sales deck (.pptx) with customizable styles and speaker notes.

- Editable SKILL.md + install-ready structure you can drop into Claude Code or the ~/.claude/skills folder so your team can reuse and version these skills across Claude apps and the API.
